knowledge.title: Gojo Satoru: Limitless and Infinity
knowledge.body: Vô Hạ Hạn (Limitless) là thuật thức liên quan đến không gian của Gojo. Infinity là trạng thái phòng thủ: thứ tiến lại gần bị làm chậm dần, tạo cảm giác không thể chạm tới anh. Blue gắn với sức hút, Red với sức đẩy, còn Purple kết hợp hai dạng đó. Lục Nhãn (Six Eyes) là khả năng riêng, hỗ trợ Gojo nhận biết và kiểm soát chú lực rất chính xác. Không nên đồng nhất Lục Nhãn với Vô Hạ Hạn, hoặc khẳng định Purple luôn xóa mọi vật chất tuyệt đối.

knowledge.title: Neon Horizon: a spoiler-light introduction
knowledge.body: Neon Horizon is an original fictional Fan Hub setting: a luminous city between two skies, where small promises matter more than spectacular powers. This sample introduction focuses on the setting and the theme of belonging. The supplied demo is not a complete film script, so a scene-by-scene plot summary or ending cannot be supported.
knowledge.sourceLabel: Original Fan Hub V1 fictional catalog; introductory sample, not a released film

knowledge.title: How to write a useful film or music review
knowledge.body: Start with a clear personal view, then support it with two or three specific observations about the work. For a film, discuss pacing, sound, acting or visual choices. For a song, discuss instrumentation, structure and the feeling it creates. Mark spoilers before revealing plot details. Distinguish your interpretation from verified facts, and quote only brief passages that you are entitled to use.

knowledge.title: Quarterly gifts: participation rules
knowledge.body: The prototype offers one free entry per eligible member per quarter after explicit acceptance of the rules. Likes, comments, purchases and time spent do not add entries. Accounts must be active; a live campaign also requires email verification and a promoter-approved eligibility policy. All trips and cinema prizes shown in this build are illustrative. No prize is being sold or actually awarded. The server, not a browser animation, must determine and store the draw result.

posts.title: The quiet scenes are the ones I remember.
posts.subject: Neon Horizon
posts.body:
There is something lovely about a story that lets a city breathe. The moments between the big events can tell us more about a character than a dramatic speech.

In this fictional Fan Hub world, I would love to see more of the ordinary places: the late-night bookshop, a familiar train platform, a light left on for a friend. For me, those details are what make an imagined place feel lived in.

Which small visual detail makes a world feel real to you?

posts.title: A soundtrack should leave room for silence.
posts.subject: Orbit / original demo audio
posts.body:
I have been listening to the short original audio sample in the media room. It made me think about how a soundtrack can support a scene without telling us exactly what to feel.

My favourite sound design often starts with restraint. A little space between notes, a distant texture, then one clear melodic idea. What soundtrack do you return to when you want to slow down?

posts.title: After the credits: what makes you recommend a film?
posts.subject: Weekend film club
posts.body:
I rarely recommend a film because it is perfect. I recommend it because there is one scene, one performance or one idea that I want to discuss with someone else.

For this week's conversation, choose one thing you value most: a memorable character, an unusual visual style, or a question that stays with you. Keep the discussion spoiler-light so everyone can join.

comments.body: For me, it is the sound of a place. A train platform can tell a whole story.
